text: いま　キャンペーン　ちゅう　だろ　ゾーン　いちばん　おくの　こやで　しょうひんを　くれるってさ！

structure.jp: いま　キャンペーン　ちゅう　だろ
structure.en: there's a campaign on right now, right?

structure.jp: ゾーン　いちばん　おくの　こやで
structure.en: at the hut in the deepest part of the Zone

structure.jp: しょうひんを　くれるってさ！
structure.en: I hear they give you a prize!

patterns.name: 〜って (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: って at the end passes on something the speaker heard from others, and さ makes it sound breezy. くれるってさ = 'they say they'll give you one'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is the short, rough form of だろう, used here to check that the listener agrees. キャンペーン ちゅう だろ = 'there's a campaign on, right?'.
